lead_raw_text:
The structure of Hg4S4Br4O4 (reduced formula HgSBrO) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmc2₁ (No. 36), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Hg centers as octahedral, coordinated by four Br and two O neighbors, while S centers show four geometric neighbors (two Br, two O). Hg octahedra share corners and edges with one another and with S-centered polyhedra, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
